content.question: Match each embedding concept with its description.

answer.Skip-gram: Predicts context words from the center word; robust for rare words
answer.CBOW: Predicts the center word from its surrounding context; faster to train
answer.Negative sampling: Learns to separate true (word, context) pairs from randomly sampled negative words instead of a full softmax
answer.GloVe: Trained on global co-occurrence statistics, combining count-based and prediction-based ideas
answer.fastText: Represents words as bags of character n-grams, handling rare and out-of-vocabulary words
